notes: All 19 displayed numeric cells plus the central-reference dash were checked visually against Tables 1 and 2 in arXiv:2502.06376v3. No uncertainty or seed count is reported for these entries.
The Table 2 mean-accuracy difference is 79.47 - 67.60 = 11.87 percentage points. Traffic reduction is (20.43 - 8.04)/20.43 × 100 = 60.6461%, rounded to 60.6%.

Table captions call bitrate millions of bits per task; the experimental setup specifies communicated bits per task in a round. Preserve M bits/task/round rather than MB, total training traffic or speedup.
MaT-FL uses 300 rounds; all other displayed federated methods use 100. Tables use 30 clients, one local epoch, 20% participation, and ViT-B/32 with rank-16 LoRA.

Independent centralized accuracy is 90.21 in both source tables, leaving 90.21 - 79.47 = 10.74 percentage points in the multi-task setting. Missing centralized communication is a dash and is excluded from the traffic chart, never coerced to zero.

The one-task table selects the strongest federated reference FedPer, related MaT-FL, MaTU and centralized reference. All six federated methods remain visible in the main multi-task charts. No insight-data correction was needed.
